milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the polished andesite path and face it. The polished andesite path starts at spawn-relative (0, -1, 0) and extends to (1, -1, 8). We target the middle of the path at (0, -1, 4) with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 so the player just needs to look at the path, which is directly in front of spawn.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate to the building interior and face the cake. The cake is placed at spawn-relative (5, 1, 12) on top of an oak plank pedestal. max_distance=16 allows detection from the building entrance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the cake.

Uses inventory_has because mining an oak_pressure_plate drops it as an item that ends up in the player's inventory. The player must break one of the two oak pressure plates placed on the floor at spawn-relative (4, 0, 12) and (3, 0, 12). Mining a pressure plate yields 1 oak_pressure_plate item in inventory.
